article.headline: Dockery's 27 lead Howard past UNC Wilmington 88-83
article.description: — Marcus Dockery scored 27 points as Howard beat UNC Wilmington 88-83 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Dockery's 27 lead Howard past UNC Wilmington 88-83
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Marcus Dockery scored 27 points as Howard beat UNC Wilmington 88-83 on Saturday. Dockery added seven assists for the Bison (5-6). Blake Harper scored 18 points while shooting 5 for 11 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 8 from the free-throw line and added seven rebounds. Joshua Strong had 18 points and shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 4 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line. The Seahawks (7-3) were led by Khamari McGriff, who recorded 34 points. Sean Moore added 13 points for UNC Wilmington. Harlan Obioha had 12 points. Howard used a 12-2 second-half run to erase a four-point deficit and take the lead at 82-76 with 2:14 remaining in the half before finishing off the victory. Harper scored 12 second-half points. Howard takes on Drexel at home on Tuesday, and UNC Wilmington hosts FGCU on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
